en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph taken from a biplane, showing a fortified peninsula jutting into the sea with massive walls and bastions, likely an old fortress. Behind it lies a dense historic town with long waterfront buildings and a straight seafront promenade. Hills and additional coastline appear in the background. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed near the bottom right.
